help:
usage: gnd review panel [-h] --out OUT [--reviewer-timeout REVIEWER_TIMEOUT]
                        [--overall-timeout OVERALL_TIMEOUT]
                        [--max-output-bytes MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES]
                        request

Load and digest-bind a review request, attempt all six reviewers concurrently
under one shared deadline, and publish the normalized request, four raw
streams and one closed envelope per reviewer, every validated response, and a
manifest-last run.json into a directory that must not already exist. REQUEST
and every artifact it names are repository-relative paths resolved against the
directory you are standing in. Every bound must be strictly positive and is
validated BEFORE any process is spawned; each reviewer's deadline is the
earlier of --reviewer-timeout and the remaining --overall-timeout. Prints one
closed JSON summary and never a verdict, a rate, or a conformance result.
Exits 0 when at least three distinct reviewers returned schema-valid
responses, 16 when all six attempts completed and fewer than three did, 3 when
the request or a reviewer-cited artifact is ill-formed, 11 when the output
directory already exists (nothing was written and no reviewer was invoked), 64
on usage errors including a non-positive bound, 66 when the request or a
reviewed artifact is missing, 70 on an internal defect, 74 on refused or
failed path/IO.

positional arguments:
  request               repository-relative path to the review request JSON
                        (kind plan, experiment-outcome, or spec-results-
                        delta), resolved against the current directory

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --out OUT             directory to publish immutable panel evidence into; it
                        must not exist
  --reviewer-timeout REVIEWER_TIMEOUT
                        positive finite per-reviewer wall-clock bound in
                        seconds (default: 600)
  --overall-timeout OVERALL_TIMEOUT
                        positive finite whole-panel wall-clock bound in
                        seconds (default: 900)
  --max-output-bytes MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES
                        positive retained byte cap per reviewer stream; the
                        whole-panel aggregate is twice this value (default:
                        536870912 -- effectively uncapped; pass a smaller
                        value to bound a run)
